description: KNa₂AlH₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one KNa₂AlH₆ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(-1), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. K is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four H atoms. There are a spread of K-H bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.96 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three H atoms. There is one shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Na-H bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.61 Å. Al is bonded in a water-like geometry to two H atoms. Both Al-H bond lengths are 1.67 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.76 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent K and one Al atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one H atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Al atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Na atoms. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one K and two Na atoms.
